decisions.reason: The possible removal of the data-level shifter is tentative and is already represented by the candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event; no confirmed MODIFY is entailed.
Separate LED and sensor power control does not change the indicator board's role, LED count, or unresolved LED-part selection.
The existing same-message Event records independent controls but leaves stale shared-rail and whole-rail shutdown semantics that conflict with the new control topology.

decisions.reason: Separate LED and sensor control could require another enable signal or a connector change, but the source does not identify the control location, signal, or revised pinout.
The source does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, connector types, pinouts, or count.
The separate control concerns LED and 5V sensor power and does not alter the standalone USB 3.3V supply requirements.
Independent load control does not necessarily change the requirement to monitor the 3.3V and 5V rails or the established monitoring channels.
The LED and sensor power-control architecture is unrelated to the BOOT and reset circuit.
The source does not change the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, or VSYS power-path requirements.
The electrical control-topology change does not entail any mechanical-layout modification.
Separate sensor and LED power control does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C mode selection.
The source does not change the panel controls, GPIO assignments, or connector mounting.
